summary: Suppress active near-duplicate alerts for a configurable time window.
adjacent_dependencies: AlertService.API/Program.cs for existing TimeProvider and service composition
AlertService.API.Tests test doubles and IAlertService consumers
constraints: Use UTC timestamps from the existing TimeProvider path; do not hardcode the suppression duration.
Compare Title case-insensitively, Severity exactly, IsActive true, and CreatedDate within the configured minutes.
Return the existing alert and X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true with 200 OK when suppressed; preserve 201 Created for new alerts.
Keep controller -> service -> repository layering and async cancellation behavior.
No schema change is expected; review query shape and existing SQL/EF conventions.
Full dotnet test may include unrelated ALERT-411/ALERT-412 integration expectations; use focused commands while implementing this slice.
coverage_goals: Suppresses a matching active alert within the configured window and returns the existing response/header.
Creates a new alert for inactive, different-severity, case-insensitive-nonmatching-title, and expired matches.
Preserves 201 Created behavior for genuinely new alerts and validates configuration usage.
